title: Web: Week
description: GET /api/coach/week?week=YYYY-Www (default: the check-in week holding today). The check-in week: the 7 days the weekly check-in judges (start..end, Monday-Sunday without a check-in day), named by the ISO week of its last day. A judged week comes from the stored check-in (its facts, verdict and report); a week in progress shows what is known so far, without a decision. Proposals are shown read-only: approving, rejecting and countering stay in Telegram. This schema is the envelope; the number blocks are view parts with their own schemas (web_week_<key>.schema.json, checked by fa_coach.views.errors).

proposal.description: A proposal, read-only. change: what it changes in plain words. guardrail.details: one line per failed guardrail, written by code, with the first check-in that could pass it (null when waiting doesn't help). applied_on: the day an approved change applied. mfp_goal_after_kcal: the MyFitnessPal goal approving an open proposal would set. avg_daily_target_kcal: the average daily target before and after (an open calorie change: now and if approved today; an approved one: as applied).

state.description: in_progress: the week holding today (no decision yet). decided: a stored check-in. awaiting: over, its check-in hasn't run yet. failed: its check-in failed and nothing changed. none: no check-in judges this week (no phase, the phase started mid-week).

phase_week.description: The phase week of the week's last day; null without a phase.

prev_week.description: The week before, back to the first phase's start; null at the start.

next_week.description: The week after; null for the week in progress.

checkin_at.description: When the check-in judges (or judged) this week; null without a check-in time.

note.description: One plain line for a week without a decision (awaiting, failed, none); null otherwise.

decision.description: The stored check-in's decision (state decided), else null. outcome: change when the week's calorie change got past the guardrails (open, approved or decided otherwise in Telegram), else hold. direction: where the week's data points, counted towards confirmation. skip: why the week didn't count (it neither counts nor breaks a streak), in one line by code.

so_far.description: A week in progress: the days so far (start..today), the weigh-ins and the days with food logged. Null otherwise.

proposals.description: The proposals based on this week, plus, for the week in progress, every open proposal. Oldest first.

report.description: The weekly report as sent to Telegram (state decided); null otherwise.

reviews.description: The reviews (block, phase, photo) sent in Telegram during this week (by the local date they were sent), oldest first, with their text as sent. Read-only.

title.description: Block review, Phase review or Photo review.

period_start.description: The first day the review looks back over.

period_end.description: The last day it looks back over.
